1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: a processor performing the steps of determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein said method further comprises __comparing the biometric user authentication with biometric authentication data obtained from a real-time biometric scan of the recipient to verify the recipient's identity and current liveness__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, and wherein __the biometric user authentication is verified against a stored biometric template associated with the recipient's account__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor performs a liveness detection algorithm on biometric data associated with the at least one payment transaction__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor performs a liveness detection algorithm on biometric data associated with the at least one payment transaction__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor verifies that the biometric authentication occurred within a threshold time period before the benefit payment determination__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the biometric user authentication is recorded in an immutable transaction log maintained by the processor__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor receives biometric authentication data directly from the mobile device__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, and wherein __the processor executes the electronic monetary transfer only after confirming the biometric proof-of-life__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, and wherein __the processor logs the biometric proof-of-life verification prior to initiating check generation__.

10. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: a processor performing the steps of determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, wherein __the processor performs a liveness detection analysis on the biometric user authentication data to confirm the recipient's current liveness status__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, and wherein __the processor maintains a secure record of all biometric authentications and corresponding timestamps__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor maintains a secure record of all biometric authentications and corresponding timestamps__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor performs the liveness detection analysis using facial recognition or fingerprint verification algorithms__.

14. (Currently Amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein __the processor compares the biometric user authentication with biometric authentication data obtained from a real-time biometric scan of the recipient to verify the recipient's identity and current liveness__.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, and wherein __the processor verifies the biometric user authentication against a stored biometric template associated with the recipient's account__.

16. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor performs a liveness detection algorithm on biometric data associated with the at least one payment transaction__.

17. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor performs a liveness detection algorithm on biometric data associated with the at least one payment transaction__.

18. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor verifies that the biometric authentication occurred within a threshold time period before the benefit payment determination__.

19. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the biometric user authentication is recorded in an immutable transaction log maintained by the processor__.

20. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor receives biometric authentication data directly from the mobile device__.
